verdict.rationale: Vestd is an equity-management SaaS, so user-configurable background automations are a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows only fixed, built-in automatic behaviours: Companies House is updated after share issuance, filing is automated, and HR data syncs from connected platforms. None of these is a user-defined automation or workflow that runs autonomously, so they count as adjacent features and earn no credit. The pack has no evidence of rules, triggers, scheduled jobs or agentic workflows that users can set up.
